answer: It sounds like you are experiencing issues with your multi-factor authentication (MFA) codes being rejected. This can happen for a few reasons. First, please check that automatic time synchronization is enabled on the device generating the codes, as a device clock drift of more than thirty seconds can invalidate time-based codes. If your device is lost, you will need to sign in using one of your recovery codes and then re-enroll a new device from the security page. If you do not have any recovery codes available, an account administrator can reset multi-factor authentication for your account. If you are the sole administrator and lack recovery codes, you will need to verify your identity through support, which may take up to one business day. Please let us know if you need further assistance with this issue.[DOC-AUTH-002]

answer: Yes, cursors do expire after one hour. For long-running iterations, you should handle this expiry by restarting from a recorded checkpoint to ensure continuity in your data retrieval process. If you need to manage large result sets, consider using cursor pagination to avoid issues with skipped or repeated records when items are inserted mid-iteration. Additionally, keep your page size at or below two hundred, as larger requests are rejected rather than truncated.[DOC-API-002]

answer: I understand your concern regarding the higher-than-expected invoice. There are several common causes for this issue. It could be due to usage-based charges that exceeded your plan allowance, or perhaps a resource was left running in a non-production environment, which is billed at the same rate as production. Additionally, the billing period runs from the anniversary of your subscription date rather than aligning with the calendar month, which might also affect the invoice amount. To investigate further, I recommend opening the usage breakdown for the period, which itemises charges by service and environment, and checking for any unexpected resource usage. You can also set a usage alert on the billing page to monitor unexpected accruals in the future.[DOC-BILL-001]
